AO and AQ contain [#47063](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47063) and [#47045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47045). Neither shows the decode-PP watchdog hang.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]` [#44404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44404) ([`8a4239fb`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/8a4239fbdcd7dedb5a4cf96ba17a0cec558bae2b)) bumped Mooncake to v0.3.14-rc1, and [#45519](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45519) ([`7e0e2594`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/7e0e259435a4cc73df71e096607d5fd219458c7b)) set `MOONCAKE_DISABLE_HIP_DMABUF=1`. Together they route intra-node transfers over Mooncake's HIP transport: `chosen=hip` is absent on Oct 17 and present since Oct 22. Occasionally one batch stalls past 30 s.
The log does not show which transport carried the stalled batch.
The same pin passed in AP and AR today.
The OOM runs between the two PRs make them impossible to separate in CI history.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ⚠️ [#45759](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45759) (open, `blocked`) re-enables HIP dma-buf, but it is not confirmed to fix this symptom. Nothing open targets the timeout itself.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: on one fabric node, A/B three setups: the current config, `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_SEND_AUX_TCP=1`, and #45759's config. Count the timeouts in each.
